title: **Turkey Revokes Operating License of a Bank Mellat Branch**
text:
**Turkey Revokes Operating License of a Bank Mellat Branch**"

"🔹 Turkey’s Official Gazette announced that the operating license of Bank Mellat’s Istanbul branch has been revoked. Turkey’s banking regulator has not disclosed the reason for the decision."

"🔹 Bank Mellat has operated in Turkey for decades and has three branches, in Istanbul, Ankara and Izmir."

"But is there a precedent?"
"🔸 Bank Mellat had previously faced similar restrictions in the UK and the European Union, which it succeeded in having lifted."

"🔸 In 2009, the UK Treasury imposed restrictions on financial transactions with the bank, which were lifted in 2013 by a UK Supreme Court ruling."

"🔸 The European Union also froze Bank Mellat’s assets in 2010, but the General Court of the European Union removed the bank from its sanctions list in 2013.
